name: Shoulder flexion / abduction (draft)
targetPopulation: Adult rehabilitation patients with shoulder mobility limitation, able to perform active-assisted or active range of motion while seated or standing. PLACEHOLDER - not a clinical inclusion/exclusion criterion; see docs/study-charter-skeleton.md.
contraindications: Acute rotator cuff tear or recent shoulder surgery without clinician clearance
symptomStopRules: Stop immediately on sharp shoulder pain or a sensation of instability/giving way
Stop on new numbness or tingling in the arm or hand and report to clinician
Stop immediately on dizziness or breathlessness
